And when he had looked round about upon all
. Having seen or examined everything. He saw the abominations and abuses which he afterwards corrected. It may be wondered at, that he did not
correct them, instead of waiting to another day. But it may be observed that God is slow to anger, that he does not
smite the guilty, but waits patiently before he rebukes and chastises.

. The evening; the time after three o'clock, P.M. It is very probable that this was before sunset. The religious services of the temple closed, without the offering of the evening sacrifice, at three o'clock, P. M., and Jesus probably soon left the city.

Literally, "Have the faith of God." This may mean, Have strong faith. or have confidence in God; a strong belief that he is able to accomplish things that appear most difficult with infinite ease, as the fig-tree was made to wither away by a word.

. When ye pray. It seems that the posture in prayer was sometimes standing and sometimes kneeling. God looks upon

rather than upon our position in worship; and if the heart be right, any posture may be proper.
